jobs.description:
About OpenLoop

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

About The Role

We're building the IT organization from the ground up at OpenLoop Health, a fast-growing telehealth platform scaling our AI-powered care delivery across digital health, brick-and-mortar, and enterprise segments. As Director of IT Operations, you'll lead the operational backbone of our infrastructure designing and scaling systems that reliably support thousands of concurrent patients, clinicians, and partners while maintaining the security and compliance standards required in healthcare.

This is a high-leverage role reporting directly to the VP of Enterprise Technology. You'll build and lead a team of 11 engineers and operators focused on infrastructure reliability, incident response, and leveraging AI to transform IT operations (automation, predictive monitoring, intelligent alerting, and beyond). You'll own IT operations strategy and be instrumental in shaping how AI improves our operational efficiency, reliability, and decision-making.

What You'll Do

IT Operations & Infrastructure

Lead a team of 10+ global resources focused on help desk services, facility management, SOC policy enforcement, and asset management
Design and oversee infrastructure architecture for 99.5%+ uptime in a healthcare SaaS environment
Deliver a helpdesk service to maintain a 95% SLA within the response and resolution framework
Co-own incident management, escalation protocols, and post-incident review culture
Manage infrastructure spend and cloud resource optimization (AWS, GCP, or multi-cloud)
Lead technical standardization across development, security, and product teams

AI-Enhanced Operations

Identify and implement AI/ML tools to improve operational efficiency (predictive alerting, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis)
Experiment with AI-driven automation for routine operational tasks
Work with OpenLoop's AI Program to understand how AI can transform IT operations and share learnings
Build a culture of intelligent observability—moving from reactive to predictive operations
Evaluate emerging AI/ML tooling for infrastructure, monitoring, and incident response

AI Program Operations Support

Work alongside the VP of Enterprise Technology to operationalize the AI Program
Define operational requirements for AI model deployment, monitoring, and governance
Establish observability and alerting standards for AI systems at scale
Build operational runbooks and playbooks that enable safe, rapid experimentation

Security & Compliance

Partner with Security to ensure operational practices support SOC 2, HIPAA, and state healthcare compliance
Manage access control, secrets management, and least-privilege architectures
Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning
Lead quarterly compliance audits and remediation workflows

Reliability & Performance

Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical services and own performance against them
Build a culture of blameless postmortems and continuous improvement
Design monitoring, alerting, and observability infrastructure
Lead capacity planning and infrastructure roadmap

Stakeholder Management

Communicate infrastructure health, risks, and roadmap to leadership and cross-functional teams
Support product and engineering teams with infrastructure provisioning and troubleshooting
Manage relationships with vendors and cloud providers
Mentor and develop operational staff

Required

Who You Are

8+ years in IT operations, infrastructure engineering, or site reliability roles
5+ years in a leadership role managing technical teams (5+ direct reports)
Proven experience operating mission-critical SaaS or healthcare platforms
Deep expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code
Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, security baselines, and healthcare regulations
Experience designing systems for 99.5%+ uptime and handling production incidents
Track record of building strong operational cultures (automation-first, blameless postmortems, on-call excellence)
Comfortable in ambiguity—ability to build processes from scratch in a fast-growing organization

Experience building IT organizations in early-stage/hypergrowth companies
Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern DevOps stacks
Background in healthcare (EMR/EHR systems, telehealth platforms, etc.)
Experience supporting machine learning or AI infrastructure at scale
Familiarity with database operations, replication, and backup/recovery strategies
Knowledge of healthcare data architecture and privacy requirements
Startup experience or consulting background
Experience evaluating or implementing AI/ML tooling for operations (predictive alerting, AIOps platforms, etc.)
Track record of using AI to improve operational efficiency or decision-making

Medical, Dental, and Vision plans

Flexible PTO

k:

A minimum of 12 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, transportation systems integration, back-office platforms, roadside technology, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.

Responsibilities

The Technology department at PJT is responsible for creating and continuously improving a robust and secure technology foundation that supports the firm's business activities. As artificial intelligence becomes deeply embedded in both internal operations and the broader vendor ecosystem, the firm faces a new and rapidly evolving risk surface. The AI Security & Risk Manager will be PJT's dedicated subject matter expert at the intersection of AI and security, helping the firm navigate this landscape with rigor and clarity.

We are seeking a high-performing AI Security & Risk professional to join the Cybersecurity team. Reporting to the Head of Technology Risk, this individual will own the firm's approach to identifying, assessing, and managing risk introduced by AI — both through internal AI deployments and through vendors increasingly embedding AI into their platforms. The role requires a practitioner who can operate at both a strategic and technical level: fluent in AI architecture and threat modeling while equally capable of communicating risk clearly to senior leadership and regulators. The candidate must build strong relationships across Technology, Legal, Compliance, and the business to ensure AI risk is managed as an enterprise priority, not a silo.

AI Risk Governance & Strategy

Own and maintain the firm's AI risk framework, covering model risk, data privacy, adversarial threats, third-party AI, and regulatory compliance.
Develop and enforce AI usage policies in collaboration with Legal and Compliance, including acceptable use, data classification requirements, and prompt handling standards.
Maintain an inventory of AI tools deployed firm-wide — both sanctioned and shadow — and assess associated risk profiles.

Monitor the evolving regulatory environment for AI (EU AI Act, SEC guidance, DORA, NY DFS) and advise on compliance obligations and required controls.

Vendor AI Evaluation & Third-Party Risk

Develop and maintain a structured AI vendor evaluation framework, incorporating criteria for model governance, output reliability, data residency, and incident response obligations.
Partner with Procurement and Legal to ensure AI-specific provisions are reflected in vendor contracts, including data usage restrictions, model change notifications, and liability terms.
Maintain a tiered risk register of third-party AI integrations, with ongoing monitoring for material changes to vendor AI functionality, architecture, or ownership.
Engage directly with vendor security and product teams to assess AI-related controls and drive remediation of identified gaps.

Conduct threat modeling for AI systems and integrations, including risks from prompt injection, model inversion, training data poisoning, and adversarial inputs.
Evaluate AI-specific attack surfaces introduced by LLM integrations, agentic workflows, and MCP-connected data sources.
Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to embed AI security controls into deployment pipelines and system design reviews.
Assess risks associated with AI-generated content, including deepfake vectors, synthetic phishing, and automated social engineering in the context of financial services.
Contribute to the firm's broader security architecture by ensuring AI components are assessed within the existing control framework.

Internal AI Program Oversight

Serve as the security and risk point of contact for the firm's internal AI deployments, including Claude Enterprise and any future platform integrations.
Evaluate data retention, access control, and logging practices for AI platforms to ensure alignment with the firm's compliance and eDiscovery obligations.
Provide risk assessments for proposed AI use cases across the firm, including a structured framework for approving, conditionally approving, or declining adoption.

Director – IT Product Solutions

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to this position.
Team Leadership and Management:
Provide strong leadership to a team of business analysts, including setting clear expectations, providing guidance, and fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
Recruit, hire, onboard, and train new individual contributors as needed.
Conduct performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and mentor team members to enhance their skills and career growth.
Strategic Planning:
Collaborate with senior leadership to understand the organization's technology strategy and translate it into actionable goals for the business analyst team.
Align the activities of the business analyst team with the company's overall technology roadmap.
Project Management:
Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects that require business analysis expertise.
Ensure that project scopes, requirements, and objectives are well-defined and clearly communicated to all stakeholders.
Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and develop mitigation strategies to keep projects on track.
Requirements Analysis:
Work closely with business stakeholders, users, and subject matter experts to gather, analyze, and document detailed business and functional requirements for technology initiatives.
Ensure that requirements are well-documented, clear, and aligned with the overall project goals.
Process Improvement:
Identify opportunities for process improvement within the technology organization and across business units.
Collaborate with business analysts to develop and implement streamlined processes and best practices for requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
Stakeholder Communication:
Act as a bridge between technology teams and business stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and understanding between the two groups.
Present findings, project updates, and recommendations to executive leadership and other relevant internal and external stakeholders.
Quality Assurance:
Implement quality assurance practices to ensure that requirements are accurate, complete, and meet the needs of the business.
Develop and oversee testing strategies to validate that technology solutions meet the defined requirements.
Change Management:
Facilitate change management activities related to technology projects, ensuring that users and stakeholders are prepared for and comfortable with the changes being implemented.
Technical Knowledge:
Maintain a strong understanding of the organization's technology landscape, including relevant tools, platforms, and industry trends.
Stay up-to-date with advancements in technology and business analysis methodologies.
Collaboration and Cross-Functional Engagement:
Collaborate with other technology teams, such as development, QA, and project management, to ensure seamless coordination and integration of business analysis activities.
Budget and Resource Management:
Manage the budget and resources allocated to the business analyst team, ensuring efficient utilization of resources and alignment with strategic goals.
Documentation and Reporting:
Maintain accurate and organized documentation related to requirements, project plans, and other relevant artifacts.
Provide regular status updates and reports to executive leadership and other stakeholders.
Sales Support:
Provide support to the sales process as it relates to the Managed Services Delivery Platform
Participation in both RFP narrative response and presence in oral presentations.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) in a technology related field
10+ years of relevant industry and role experience
5+ years of experience working in and/or supporting a Managed Services environment.
ServiceNow Design Experience and Expertise
ITIL Foundations Certification is recommended. ITIL Design, Transition, Operations, and CSI are a plus.
Can define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions to benefit the organization and maintain client satisfaction.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with others, which could include multiple levels of management and external clients and vendors.
Must be able to work with and lead a geographically dispersed team.
